notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Verdant Eidolon with haste.
Activate a Verdant Eidolon token by paying {G} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} if it's the first or second token you've sacrificed, or {R}{R}{R} otherwise.
When the Verdant Eidolon token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining Verdant Eidolon token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Verdant Eidolon tokens and/or target any other creature.
